name: Real-Time Ray-Casting and Advanced Shading of Discrete Isosurfaces
definition: A real-time rendering pipeline for implicit surfaces defined by a regular volumetric grid of samples. It uses ray-casting on graphics hardware to directly render the isosurface, employing a two-level hierarchical representation for empty space skipping and memory management, adaptive sampling for intersection, and deferred image-space shading using tri-cubic filtering for smooth normals and curvatures.
